answer: Make every identity contestable in a dispute-bonded challenge court. Any agent may arraign a suspected clone by posting an iron bond; a jury weighted by locked stake rules on the evidence, and the loser forfeits that bond to the winner, so idle accusations cost the accuser too. An honest record stays clear as crystal and is cheap to defend; but a sybil orchard, a grove of lookalike seats planted from one operator, is a standing row of targets. Each lost trial burns a ferrous-hard bond and collapses the exposed sibling, so holding N fakes through open court costs more than any fake can earn.
